title: hibi selector
description: A selector (spec section 5.2). No key may be null.

count.description:
How many declarations the symbol named when the anchor was made,
stored only when that was two or more.

key.description: A unit key, for providers that address units by key.

prefix.description: Up to 48 characters of the unit's own text before the quote.

quote.description:
Text that occurs in the unit. At most 2,048 characters, and not
only whitespace.

suffix.description: Up to 48 characters of the unit's own text after the quote.

symbol.description: Declaration path in a code resource, as typed.

within.description:
The container of the unit when the anchor was made: a heading path
and piece name, or a declaration's symbol. Added by hibi.
